title: Tales per-plugin catalog envelope
description: Base for every R/<Feature>/<Plugin.ext>.json. Per-feature schemas allOf-reference this and add their sections. Sections are arrays of entries (or objects keyed by entry key); an entry may carry "remove": true.

formKey.description: Plugin.ext:HEX; writers emit uppercase, 6 digits for full plugins. HEX:Plugin, bare hex and decimal ids are not accepted.

removeFlag.description: true deletes the earlier plugin's entry with the same key

removeMarker.description: Map-section value that erases its key from earlier plugins

remove.description: true deletes the earlier plugin's entry with the same key
